B. Amazon S3
C. AWS Config
D. AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager
E. AWS Lambda

D. AWS Systems Manager patch manager - This service is specifically designed to manage software patches across your fleet of instances, ensuring that security updates are applied consistently without manual intervention. It integrates well with the CI/CD process for automated patching.

E. AWS Lambda - While useful for serverless functions and automation, it does not directly address the needs for managing configurations independently or automating patch management.
